It usually takes at least 4-6 weeks of stable dosing to reach steady state after each dose adjustment. If myelosuppression occurs, emphasis should be on reducing thioguanine over other agents.
rows.comments: Standard starting doses may vary by patient characteristics and/or treatment regimens and according to local clinical practice.
